carrier.claim: Orange O block w/ yellow Y ring moves with UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT along black pipe (snake body, tail retracts). A peg may jump ONTO carrier cell and then RIDES it; drive it to another board socket and jump off, capturing.

game1.claim: L-shaped 7x7-ish board, green plus pegs, click peg=select (dark ring) + shows g-ring on legal jump landings; looks like peg solitaire

goal.claim: Win = exactly ONE green peg left on all boards. Stalemate with >1 peg drains all pegs = fail; a purple reset key then appears (click to restart level).

jump.claim: Click peg to select (G ring + g landing rings), click landing cell to jump 1-over-1 capturing jumped peg. Arrow keys do nothing unless carrier moves.
